acl.description: List of {@link AclEntry} entries governing who can read/update/remove Objs.

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

name.description: Additional display name for the sensor. This is the secondary name used to display this sensor in the UI.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

locationHistory.description: The historical location/address for the asset.

location.description: The current location/address for this asset.

realTimeLocations.description: Real-time location data for a moving asset.

parentRelations.description: Parent relations, where 'to' refers to this asset.

childRelations.description: Child relations, where 'from' refers to this asset.

denormAncestors.description: Ancestors in the asset hierarchy throughout history.

denormDescendants.description: Descendants in the asset hierarchy throughout history.

relativePositionHistory.description: The historical relative positions of this physical asset.

relativePosition.description: The current relative position of this physical asset.

measurements.description: Physical measurement series related to this asset.

pointMeasurements.description: Point measurement series for time-series metrics related to the asset.

events.description: The event history for this physical asset.

childSensorRelations.description:
The {@link Sensor}s associated with this {@link PhysicalAsset}.

This field establishes the relationship between the physical asset and its associated sensors,
using a filter to only include sensors in the relation (where the type of relation is 'SENSOR').

sensorType.description:
The type of data series that describes a measurement value on an asset.
In a typical deployment, the types of sensors include, but are not limited to,
TAGs, LMIs, VSLs, etc.

tag.description:
Reference to a data series describing a measurement value on an asset
(e.g., pressure, temperature, flow rate, setpoint, process value);
usually an alphanumeric identifier "61PI0207"
This is the primary name field used to display this sensor in the UI. Ideally matches the id.

compressionMax.description: Maximum compression for Pi data (in number of seconds).

status.description: The transmitting status of the sensor.

measurementBounds.description:
A Sensor will usually have lower and upper limits of
measurement data in its time series. Below the lower bound,
the data is considered invalid. Beyond the upper bound,
the data is considered invalid. Invalidity may be due to wrong
calibration of the Sensor, incorrect storage of the measurement
value in the database, human error while extracting the data, etc.
To account for these errors, there is a provision to set the lower
and upper operational measurement bounds for the time series data
of the Sensor.
For more information on how to set these bounds and manipulate them,
refer to {@link getMeasurementBounds}, {@link setMeasurementBounds},
and {@link resetMeasurementBounds}.

series.description: All measurement series, including {@link PointPhysicalMeasurementSeries} and {@link PhysicalMeasurementSeries}

maintenanceHistory.description: The last time the {@link Sensor} has had maintenance.

dataSummaries.description:
The {@link SensorDataSummary} objects for this sensor which hold aggregated statistics
about the quality of the sensor's data.

flatlinePercentage.description:
Non-persisted field populated by {@link fetchForDataThresholds} which represents the
percentage of data which is flatlined across the queried time range.

missingPercentage.description:
Non-persisted field populated by {@link fetchForDataThresholds} which represents the
percentage of data which is missing across the queried time range.

title:
Users may use this function to compute regime shifts
on the time series of Sensor values.
The arguments for the function are start, end and interval
on the Sensor values.
persistValues: persist values to FileSysten if True. NOTE: path before encoding will be
Sensor/RegimeShift/hash(sensorId)/hash(regimeShiftSpec_parameters).json
regimeShiftSpec: Spec to configure parameters of regime shift calculation
NOTE: The function checks if the regime shift has already been computed and
if it has, then the results will simply be returned from cache.
name: Sensor
